landing.title: Master Your Setlist.
landing.subtitle: The all-in-one repertoire manager for individual musicians and bands. Catalog songs, track mastery stages, share setlists, and pull up chords & tabs instantly on stage.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need For Practice & Stage
landing.featuresSubtitle: Designed to stop song knowledge from being scattered across chats and folders.
landing.f1Desc: Catalog songs with title, artist, album, key, cover art, duration, and external links to Spotify, YouTube, or Cifra Club. Songs other musicians have already catalogued arrive pre-filled — title, artist, album, key, cover art and links — so you add them in one tap.
landing.f2Desc: Track song progress with a 5-stage scale: Unknown → Learning → Practicing → Polishing → Mastered.
landing.f3Desc: Create bands, invite members with a link, and view aggregate readiness calculated automatically via the 'weakest link' rule.
landing.f4Desc: A mobile-optimized reading mode for music stands. Swipe between songs in a setlist, view lyrics with chord tags, and switch to Stage Mode.
landing.f5Desc: Attach PDF chord charts and tablatures to any song, yours or shared with your band, and write straight on them in Stage Mode with your finger or a pen. Annotations are saved per page automatically, drawing toggles on and off so you can still turn pages, and it works great on a tablet.
landing.f6Desc: Search songs directly on Spotify and import entire playlists into your personal or band repertoire with one click.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Take Your Setlist to the Next Stage?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join Repertoire Hero today and keep your music cataloged, synchronized, and gig-ready.
